beats.subtitle: 新任 CEO 与苹果交接
beats.zh: 约翰·特纳斯接任苹果新一届 CEO
beats.en: John Ternus becomes Apple's new CEO.

beats.subtitle: 首秀与公众关注
beats.zh: 秋季发布会将成为新任 CEO 的重要亮相
beats.en: The fall event becomes his first major appearance.

beats.subtitle: 机械工程师的二十五年
beats.zh: 从机械工程到苹果产品设计部门
beats.en: From mechanical engineering to Apple's product design team.

beats.subtitle: 决定 CEO 的不是资历
beats.zh: 真正让他脱颖而出的，是关键路线选择
beats.en: Decisive choices, not seniority, set him apart.

beats.subtitle: 从 Intel 到自研芯片
beats.zh: Mac 从 Intel 架构切换到 Apple Silicon
beats.en: Mac transitions from Intel to Apple Silicon.

beats.subtitle: 性能与续航的跃迁
beats.zh: M 系列带来性能和续航的双重突破
beats.en: M-series brings a leap in power and battery life.

beats.subtitle: 两年完成主力产品迁移
beats.zh: 高风险的平台切换，被苹果迅速完成
beats.en: Apple completes a high-risk platform shift at speed.

beats.subtitle: 轻薄曾经压过性能
beats.zh: 极致轻薄曾以性能、散热与接口为代价
beats.en: Thinness once came at the cost of power, cooling, and ports.

beats.subtitle: 接口与专业能力回归
beats.zh: HDMI、SD 卡槽和专业用户需求重新被看见
beats.en: HDMI, SD, and pro workflows return to the agenda.

beats.subtitle: 重新拥抱专业市场
beats.zh: MacBook Pro 重做后，苹果回到专业用户身边
beats.en: A rebuilt MacBook Pro brings Apple back to professionals.

beats.subtitle: 硬件路线的连贯性
beats.zh: iPad、Mac 与产品线被重新统一
beats.en: iPad, Mac, and the broader hardware lineup reconnect.

beats.subtitle: 从耳机到健康设备
beats.zh: AirPods 从无线耳机走向降噪与助听功能
beats.en: AirPods evolve from earbuds to ANC and hearing support.

beats.subtitle: 技术之外的组织能力
beats.zh: CEO 既要懂技术，也要有商业判断与领导力
beats.en: A CEO needs technical depth, judgment, and leadership.

beats.subtitle: 为什么市场认可他
beats.zh: 低调、协作和硬件判断，成为资本市场的信号
beats.en: Steady leadership and hardware judgment become a market signal.

beats.subtitle: 职能型组织
beats.zh: 苹果并不按产品线设立传统事业部
beats.en: Apple is organized by functions, not product divisions.

beats.subtitle: 跨职能取舍
beats.zh: 只有 CEO 能统筹跨硬件、软件与服务的取舍
beats.en: The CEO integrates tradeoffs across hardware, software, and services.

beats.subtitle: 接班人的取舍
beats.zh: 董事会最终选择了更年轻的硬件负责人
beats.en: The board ultimately chooses the younger hardware leader.

beats.subtitle: 软硬件重新结合
beats.zh: 新领导层意味着更重视硬件创新和软硬协同
beats.en: The next era emphasizes hardware innovation and integration.

beats.subtitle: 新形态硬件的窗口
beats.zh: 端侧 AI、可穿戴与新形态设备正在成为方向
beats.en: On-device AI, wearables, and new devices shape the roadmap.

beats.subtitle: 苹果的下一阶段
beats.zh: 未来的关键是如何把算力、系统和产品重新结合
beats.en: The next task is to reunite compute, systems, and products.

beats.subtitle: Vision Pro 与端侧 AI
beats.zh: 新产品形态要从展示技术变成真实体验
beats.en: New forms must become real experiences, not just demos.

beats.subtitle: 成熟业务与新增量
beats.zh: 服务业务已经成熟，新体验才是增长空间
beats.en: Services are mature; new experiences create the next growth space.

beats.subtitle: 库克留下的能力
beats.zh: 库克仍会以经验支持新任 CEO 的过渡
beats.en: Cook's experience continues to support the transition.

beats.subtitle: 乐观与担忧并存
beats.zh: 有人看好端侧 AI，也有人认为苹果起步太慢
beats.en: Some favor Apple's AI future; others fear it is late.

beats.subtitle: 算力如何变成体验
beats.zh: 真正的问题不是 AI 标签，而是它如何进入产品
beats.en: The question is not the AI label, but how it enters products.

beats.subtitle: 不必预言未来
beats.zh: 未来无法预言，但工程能力值得被认真看待
beats.en: The future is unknown, but engineering capacity matters.

beats.subtitle: 从厚实基础走向创新
beats.zh: 积累足够厚实，下一任掌舵人才能放手创新
beats.en: A strong base gives the next leader room to innovate.

beats.subtitle: 运营机器留下的基础
beats.zh: 库克时代为苹果积累了极其丰厚的能力
beats.en: The Cook era leaves Apple an exceptionally strong foundation.

beats.subtitle: 产品才是最终答案
beats.zh: 作为消费者，我们期待的不是数字，而是下一次惊喜
beats.en: As consumers, we want the next great surprise, not just metrics.

beats.subtitle: 体验必须足够出色
beats.zh: 只要产品足够强，苹果就仍然值得期待
beats.en: If the product is strong enough, Apple remains worth watching.

beats.subtitle: 你看好特纳斯吗
beats.zh: 这就是本期视频：你看好特纳斯开启的新时代吗？
beats.en: Do you believe in the Ternus era?
